turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Hi! How are you doing these days?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: I need new headphones for my commute and I'm torn.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Wait until I've listed everything before you jump in.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: One pair is big wireless noise cancelling ones, really comfy but pricey.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Then there's a cheap wired pair that sound surprisingly good for the money.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Or tiny wireless earbuds that fit in my pocket but keep falling out when I run for the bus.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: That's the full list. Go ahead.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: The noise cancelling pair is the best for a loud commute, they make trains feel quiet. The wired ones are a bargain and you never worry about charging. The earbuds are handy, but if they fall out when you run, that'll get annoying fast.
